candidates.title: Compare supplier confirmations with purchase orders

demandEvidence.chore: Manually compare each supplier confirmation against the purchase order across SKU, quantity, price, and delivery date.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: manually comparing every SKU, quantity, price, and delivery date against the original Purchase Order becomes time-consuming.

ease.reason: An operator can enter synthetic line items in a table, but no supplied reference supports document extraction or matching.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: small online retailers handling supplier confirmations might pay for review preparation; the post proves no buyer or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week test can compare operator-entered sample rows and flag differences; document intake and accuracy remain untested.

autonomy.reason: A prototype could repeat field comparisons, while a person verifies source rows and approves any purchase-order change.

evidence.reason: The post states a specific manual comparison task and fields, but gives no frequency, rules, or implementation corroboration.

candidates.reason: Concrete task assessed with a narrow synthetic row comparison; provisional mean 5.2 is below threshold, and prior assessments found no new evidence.
